headline: BROCK collapses -21.88% on 5.4x volume with no supporting filing, leading a session of unusually volatile PROP/FSIT names.
market_take: Coverage breadth is mixed: a handful of sharp downside prints in PROP and CONS sit against outsized upside in FOOD and AGRI. Volume-spike alerts are concentrated in small-cap CONS (STI 57.2σ, MADAME 8.5σ) and PF&REIT (LHSC 7.9σ), suggesting rotation rather than a sector-wide move. Filings are dominated by routine capital, REIT scheme and management changes, with CPNREIT's sublease notice the most directly price-relevant disclosure.
